title: Single-request Report Server ID analogue
purpose: Cover the Report Server ID parser entry with a minimal valid MODBUS/TCP ADU and preserve issue-guided focus on historically sensitive non-address-based function handling.
expected_behavior: Server should accept the valid 0x11 request and return server identifier and run-state information if supported, or a clean exception if not supported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0x0002 matches unit identifier plus 1-byte PDU
Function code 0x11 is documented for Report Server ID
Request contains no extraneous padding bytes
Unit identifier diversified from other seeds
issue_safety_notes: Keeps only the safe minimal valid request shape for Report Server ID and avoids the exact malformed packet forms associated with historical invalid-pointer and parser issues.
